title: Confident, Calibrated, or Complicit: Probing the Trade-offs between Safety Alignment and Ideological Bias in Language Models in Detecting Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on the performance and ideological bias of LLMs in detecting hate speech, specifically comparing models with different safety alignment levels. While it discusses safety alignment as an implementation of ethical frameworks, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, theology, or moral philosophy as a subject of study.
